name: Sharpness
summary: Adds 8% base attack damage per level; V = +40%. Penchant replaces vanilla flat Sharpness damage.

name: Smite
summary: Adds 2.5 damage per level against the sensitive_to_smite tag; V = +12.5.

name: Bane of Arthropods
summary: Adds 2.5 damage per level against arthropods; also applies Slowness IV with level-scaled random duration.

name: Knockback
summary: Adds 1 knockback-effect unit per level; II = +2.

name: Fire Aspect
summary: Ignites targets for 4 seconds per level; II = 8s.

name: Looting
summary: Increases qualifying equipment-drop probability by 1 percentage point per level. Supported tag includes the pack's crossbow extensions; ordinary loot-table bonuses also depend on the loot table.

name: Impaling
summary: Adds 2.5 damage per level against sensitive_to_impaling targets; V = +12.5.

name: Loyalty
summary: Adds 1 trident-return acceleration per level.

name: Riptide
summary: Wet-use trident propulsion strength: 1.5 / 2.25 / 3.0; native movement conditions apply.

name: Channeling
summary: Summons lightning on qualifying trident hits during thunder; also has lightning-rod hit handling.

name: Density
summary: Adds 0.5 smash damage per fallen block per level; V = +2.5 per block.

name: Breach
summary: Reduces target armor effectiveness by 15 percentage points per level; IV = 60 points.

name: Wind Burst
summary: Smash-triggered wind explosion, radius 3.5; knockback multiplier 1.2 / 1.75 / 2.2.

name: Lunge
summary: Spear lunge: horizontal impulse magnitude 0.458 per level; exhaustion 4 per level and 1 durability cost, with native food/movement restrictions.

name: Attack Speed
summary: Adds 0.1 attack_speed attribute per level; III = +0.3 attacks/s. Flat, not +10% per level.

name: Critical Hit
summary: Adds 4% of base critical_strike:chance per level; V = +20 base-percentage points with the normal base-100 attribute.

name: Critical Impact
summary: Adds 10% of base critical_strike:damage per level; V = +50 critical-multiplier percentage points with the normal base-100 attribute.

name: Frost Aspect
summary: Sets frozen ticks to 300. Both I and II pass a hardcoded effect level of 1, so II currently gives no stronger freeze.

name: Aerial's Bane
summary: Adds 2 damage per level against qualifying airborne/aerial targets; excludes specified water, mounted and bow/crossbow cases.

name: Illagers Bane
summary: Adds 2.5 damage per level against the mod's illager tag; V = +12.5.

name: Wither Coated
summary: Applies Wither I for 12s / II for 6s / III for 3s on qualifying direct hits; +1 item durability damage.

name: Discharge
summary: 15% ? level proc definition builds movement Speed through successive hits, then discharges at Speed V into a radius-2 explosion/lightning; can damage the wielder. Some conditional entries use legacy array syntax and require runtime confirmation.

name: Ensnaring
summary: 10% / 20% / 30% / 40% chance to apply Slowness XI for 2s and summon surrounding evoker fangs.

name: Lolth's Curse
summary: 30% chance for Regeneration II for 2-4s; definition also includes 20% cave-spider spawning, 4-8 reflected damage against arthropods and 10s Darkness on players. Some conditions use legacy array syntax.

name: Backstabbing
summary: Knife hits from behind multiply damage by 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8.

name: Efficiency
summary: Adds L? + 1 mining_efficiency; V = +26. Included because axes can also be weapons.

name: Power
summary: Adds 0.5 per level to arrow damage calculation; V = +2.5. This is an arrow damage input, not a guaranteed +2.5 final HP per hit.

name: Punch
summary: Adds 1 arrow knockback-effect unit per level; II = +2.

name: Flame
summary: Ignites fired arrows; native projectile fire duration is 100 seconds, distinct from the victim's burn time.

name: Infinity
summary: Prevents ammo use for qualifying normal arrows; special-arrow rules remain.

name: Quick Charge
summary: Reduces crossbow charge time by 0.25s per level; III = -0.75s.

name: Piercing
summary: Adds 1 projectile-piercing unit per level, with CrossArms projectile tagging.

name: Multishot
summary: Adds 2 projectiles per level: 3 / 5 / 7 total. Added spread 5 / 8 / 11 degrees; CrossArms function hooks also apply.

name: Frost
summary: Sets vanilla frozen ticks to 240 on projectile hits. This is vanilla freezing buildup, not RPG Frozen hard control.

name: Tri-Shot
summary: Tri-Shot: adds 2 bow projectiles (3 total) with 10 degrees additional spread.

name: Blowthrough
summary: Blowthrough: +1 bow projectile-piercing unit per level; IV = +4.

name: Might
summary: Might: adds 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 / 3 to qualifying crossbow arrow damage input.

name: Gravity
summary: Arrow impacts create pulling explosions: negative knockback multiplier -0.75 / -1 / -1.25. Entity-hit radius 6; block hits use several offset bursts, including radius 10.

name: Acceleration
summary: Projectile launch impulse magnitude 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6, plus CrossArms orientation correction.

name: Ricochet
summary: Stores the enchantment level as the arrow's bounce count: 1-4.

name: Zero Drop
summary: Removes arrow gravity; suppresses vanilla and RPG critical hits through the installed repair.

name: Frenzy
summary: Automatic crossbow firing with heat/spread and reload rules. Heat damage is 20/30/40/50% normal; slows the shooter and applies high-heat self-damage. See the current CrossArms patch for the complete firing state machine.

name: Spectral
summary: Applies Glowing for 10s on hit.

name: Sniper
summary: Distance-tiered arrow damage: at V, +1 / +2.5 / +4 / +5.5 / +7 for 10-20 / 20-30 / 30-40 / 40-50 / 50+ blocks. The definition uses array-shaped requirements; runtime validity needs confirmation.

name: Spell Power
summary: Adds 5% generic Spell Power per level; V = +25%. Generic power contributes to healing as well as offensive schools.

name: Spell Haste
summary: Adds 4% base spell haste per level; V = +20%.

name: Spell Volatility
summary: Spell Volatility: +4% base spell-critical chance per level; V = +20 points with the normal base-100 attribute.

name: Amplify Spell
summary: Amplify Spell: +10% base spell-critical damage/healing multiplier per level; V = +50 points with the normal base-100 attribute.

name: Spell Infinity
summary: Prevents consumption of rune ammunition for supported spells; does not waive cooldowns, health costs or every other spell cost.

name: Protection
summary: Adds 0.25 protection points per level: 1% general reduction per level per piece; IV = 4% per piece.

name: Projectile Protection
summary: Adds 0.25 projectile-protection points per level: 1% per level per piece; IV = 4%.

name: Fire Protection
summary: Adds 0.25 fire-protection points per level: 1% per level per piece; IV = 4%. Burning duration remains -15% base per level.

name: Blast Protection
summary: Adds 0.25 blast-protection points per level: 1% per level per piece; IV = 4%. Explosion knockback resistance remains +0.15 per level.

name: Feather Falling
summary: Adds 1.5 fall-protection points per level: 6% reduction per level, IV = 24% in the enchantment layer.

name: Thorns
summary: 15% proc chance per level; deals random 1-5 damage and costs 2 item durability when it procs.

name: Respiration
summary: Adds 1 oxygen_bonus per level; improves underwater breathing through the native oxygen calculation.

name: Aqua Affinity
summary: Multiplies submerged mining speed by 5 at level I, removing the usual underwater mining penalty.

name: Depth Strider
summary: Adds 1/3 water movement efficiency per level; III = +1.

name: Frost Walker
summary: Freezes nearby water with radius 2 + level, maximum 16; grants immunity to the defined hot-floor/campfire sources while active.

name: Soul Speed
summary: On soul-speed terrain: movement_speed +0.0405 / +0.051 / +0.0615 and movement efficiency +1. Has a 4% qualifying durability-loss chance.

name: Swift Sneak
summary: Adds 0.15 sneaking_speed per level; III = +0.45.

name: Curse of Binding
summary: Prevents ordinary removal of equipped cursed armor.

name: Magic Protection
summary: Adds 0.25 protection points per level against c:is_magic damage: 1% per level per piece; IV = 4%.

name: Energize
summary: Per armor piece: +3% base Healing and Lightning power per level; V = +15% to both.

name: Sunfire
summary: Per armor piece: +3% base Arcane and Fire power per level; V = +15% to both.

name: Soulfrost
summary: Per armor piece: +3% base Soul and Frost power per level; V = +15% to both.

name: Acrobat
summary: Chest: +20% base roll recharge rate per level; V = +100%. This changes recharge rate, not a flat -100% cooldown.

name: Longfooted
summary: Boots: +1 roll-distance attribute per level; IV = +4.

name: Multi-Roll
summary: Helmet: +1 available roll per level; III = +3.

name: Fangs
summary: Leggings: retaliatory functions summon 1 / up to 2 / up to 3 fangs; extra targets within 2/3 blocks. The 15% ? level roll applies to durability loss, not the separately defined fang summons.

name: Downfall
summary: Boot landing attack: 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 damage within 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 / 3 blocks, plus upward motion and Slowness III for 1s. Falling thresholds 3 / 4.5 / 5 / 6 blocks; user gets brief Slowness II/mining-fatigue marker.

name: Spiky
summary: Held shield retaliates for 2 / 4 / 6 damage through its advancement/function handler; conditional shield durability use.

name: Repellent
summary: 15% proc chance per level to teleport an attacker 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 blocks; costs 2 item durability on proc.

name: Purification
summary: Defined chance 0.5% per level per tick to clear poison/wither and make a radius-2 magic explosion; conditional array syntax needs runtime confirmation.

name: Outreach
summary: Chest armor adds 0.5 block interaction range per level; IV = +2 blocks. This is block reach, not melee reach.

name: End Veil
summary: Helmet: looking at Endermen does not anger them.

name: Wax Wings
summary: Elytra water-related durability/flight behavior; conditional, not a flat armor bonus.

name: Soaring Winds
summary: Elytra takeoff boost; no flat armor stat in the definition.

name: Unbreaking
section: Shared durability, curses and special material equipment
summary: Armor: ignores 8% of durability loss per level; X = 80% avoidance (about 5x lifespan). Non-armor: L/(L+1) avoidance; X = 90.91%. Max level X.

name: Mending
section: Shared durability, curses and special material equipment
summary: XP repairs 2 durability per XP point through the native repair effect.

name: Curse of Vanishing
section: Shared durability, curses and special material equipment
summary: Prevents the enchanted item from dropping on death.

name: Photosynthesis
section: Shared durability, curses and special material equipment
summary: Repairs 1 item durability on qualifying 1%-chance ticks under specified sky/day or light conditions; no flat combat stat.

name: Curse of Conductivity
section: Shared durability, curses and special material equipment
summary: Conditional lightning-attraction behavior; inspect the saved raw tick conditions for its weather/sky requirements.

name: Curse of Starvation
section: Shared durability, curses and special material equipment
summary: No effect component in the installed definition; any hunger behavior depends on an external handler and is not established by this data audit.

name: Rubys' Fire
section: Shared durability, curses and special material equipment
summary: Flaming Ruby equipment: +1 knockback when attacking; 50% retaliatory chance for 2-7 magic damage, ignition and pushback, costing 1 durability. Also smelts supported mined ores.

name: Arrow Inducting
summary: Resistor Shield transforms any deflected arrows into seeking arrows

name: Astral Transferring
summary: Mobs possessed by the Totem of Possession can swap possessed status with other, healthier mobs they fight

name: Bonking
summary: Primitive Club has a chance to drop heads from slain mobs, as if a charged Creeper killed them

name: Bouncing Bolt
summary: Sea Staff water bolt can bounce to a second target after a direct hit

name: Bouncy Ball
summary: Gumballs bounce an additional two times for each level

name: Charting Call
summary: Magic Conch summons additional Deep Ones to aide in combat

name: Chomping Spirit
summary: Extinction Spear Tremorsaurus attack deals increased damage

name: Crystallization
summary: Galena Gauntlet can move items made of crystal, such as diamond tools

name: Dark Nock
summary: Dreadbow charge time = 40 - 8L ticks: 32 / 24 / 16 ticks at I-III, versus 40 without it.

name: Dazing Sweep
summary: Adds a club stun sweep in a box of size L + 1.2: 2.2 / 3.2 blocks at I-II (box size, not radius).

name: Detonating Death
summary: Possessed-mob death explosion strength = 2 + floor(mob width).

name: Double Stab
summary: Desolate Dagger summons two ghostly daggers instead of one.

name: Energy Efficiency
summary: Raygun uses up charge at a slower rate

name: Enveloping Bubble
summary: Sea Staff water bolt can envelop the target in a drowning bubble of water

name: Explosive Flavor
summary: Shotgum fires a single slow, explosive gumball

name: Far Flung
summary: Hook launches even further when swung

name: Ferrous Haste
summary: Galena Gauntlet items attack and mine much faster

name: Field Extension
summary: Galena Gauntlet can move items further away

name: Flinging
summary: Ortholance launch moves the player much further

name: Gamma Ray
summary: Raygun beam inflicts deadly blue Irradiated effect

name: Heavy Slam
summary: Resistor Shield first slam attack deals additional damage

name: Herd Phalanx
summary: Extinction Spear summons 3 + L armored heads: 4 / 5 / 6 at I-III.

name: Humungous Hex
summary: Hex scale = 1 + 0.25L: 1.25x / 1.5x at I-II.

name: Impending Stab
summary: Ghostly dagger attack is delayed and deals increased damage

name: Lasting Morale
summary: Deep Ones summoned by Magic Conch will stay around longer

name: Multiple Mint
summary: Sugar Staff summons 3 + L peppermints: 4 / 5 at I-II.

name: Peppermint Punting
summary: Peppermints bounce directly ahead instead of around the attacker

name: Plummeting Flight
summary: Extinction Spear Subterranodon attack carries foes higher and for longer

name: Precise Volley
summary: Dreadbow arrows rain down from the sky to a more central position

name: Rapid Possession
summary: Possessed-mob navigation speed factor = 1.25 + 0.35L: 1.6 / 1.95 / 2.3 at I-III.

name: Relentless Darkness
summary: Dreadbow fires arrows directly ahead in a continuous stream

name: Sated Blade
summary: Ghostly dagger attack increases the food saturation level of the attacker

name: Sea Swing
summary: Ortholance swing attack summons a single, forwards-facing wave

name: Seapairing
summary: Sea Staff can occasionally regain durability when in the inventory of a submerged entity

name: Second Wave
summary: Ortholance summons a second, delayed wave after launching the player

name: Seekcandy
summary: Peppermints created by the staff seek out any entity the attacker looks at

name: Shaded Respite
summary: Dreadbow will not consume normal arrows or durability if fired in darkness

name: Sharp Cane
summary: Hook deals three damage per level when attaching to a target

name: Sightless
summary: Mobs possessed by the Totem of Possession can be controlled without a direct line of sight

name: Soak Seeking
summary: Sea Staff water bolts now home-in on targets more accurately

name: Solar
summary: Raygun recharges over time when user is under direct sunlight

name: Spell Lasting
summary: Hex lifespan = 100 + 60L ticks: 8 / 11 / 14 seconds at I-III.

name: Straight Hook
summary: Hook launches directly ahead and is not hindered by gravity

name: Swiftwood
summary: Primitive Club can be swung much faster

name: Targeted Ricochet
summary: Gumballs will bounce to the nearest target after hitting a wall or entity

name: Taxing Bellow
summary: Using the Magic Conch lowers the opinion held by Deep Ones, but does not decrease durability

name: Triple Splash
summary: Sea Staff fires two additional water bolts

name: Triple Split
summary: Gumballs split into three additional Gumballs after hitting their first target

name: Tsunami
summary: Ortholance launch summons a single, gigantic wave

name: Twilight Perfection
summary: Dreadbow arrows glow red and deal double damage if fired at the precise bow charge time

name: X-Ray
summary: Raygun beam pierces through walls

name: Fortune
section: Other tools, mounts and harnesses (outside player weapon/armor balance)
summary: No direct attribute: tool loot tables use the enchantment level to change drops.

name: Silk Touch
section: Other tools, mounts and harnesses (outside player weapon/armor balance)
summary: Special block-drop selection; suppresses normal block XP. No combat attribute.

name: Lure
section: Other tools, mounts and harnesses (outside player weapon/armor balance)
summary: Fishing-time reduction +5 per level in the native fishing calculation.

name: Luck of the Sea
section: Other tools, mounts and harnesses (outside player weapon/armor balance)
summary: Adds 1 fishing_luck_bonus per level.

name: Tunneling
section: Other tools, mounts and harnesses (outside player weapon/armor balance)
summary: Mining digs an additional block below; no combat attribute.

name: Resonance
section: Other tools, mounts and harnesses (outside player weapon/armor balance)
summary: Hammer mining breaks surrounding blocks; sneaking limits the effect. No direct combat attribute.

name: Obsidian Breaker
section: Other tools, mounts and harnesses (outside player weapon/armor balance)
summary: Mining-only obsidian breaking-speed behavior; no fixed combat attribute in the definition.

name: Hydro Veil
section: Other tools, mounts and harnesses (outside player weapon/armor balance)
summary: Happy-Ghast harness enchantment: environmental defenses, rain-dependent movement/healing; not player armor. Full conditional attributes are in the raw record.

name: Swift Soar
section: Other tools, mounts and harnesses (outside player weapon/armor balance)
summary: Happy-Ghast harness flying behavior; not player armor or a player combat stat.

name: Returning Board
section: Other tools, mounts and harnesses (outside player weapon/armor balance)
summary: Straddleboard returns instantly to the rider's inventory when broken.

name: Lavawaxed
section: Other tools, mounts and harnesses (outside player weapon/armor balance)
summary: Gives the rider of the Straddleboard Fire Resistance.

name: Serpent Charmer
section: Other tools, mounts and harnesses (outside player weapon/armor balance)
summary: Makes Bone Serpents neutral towards the rider of the Straddleboard.

name: Straddle Jump
section: Other tools, mounts and harnesses (outside player weapon/armor balance)
summary: Increases the height of Straddleboard jumps.

name: Sweeping Edge
summary: HIDDEN. Registered vanilla enchantment; sweep-damage ratio bonus L/(L+1). Not normally obtainable.

name: Thunder Strike
summary: Falling mace hits (fall distance at least 1 block) summon lightning on 1 / up to 2 / up to 3 targets; extra targets are within 2/3 blocks. Its separate 15% per-level roll controls durability loss.
